d: Honey-blonde hair reaches shoulder-length with a voluminous, wavy texture and blunt-cut bangs under a thin blue headband. The amber eyes are large and wide with a cheerful, open expression, set on a youthful face with a teenage level of maturity. The build is slender with soft curves, wearing a dark navy blue one-piece swimsuit with a white neckline, layered under an olive-drab sleeveless jacket with a brown shoulder strap and a small red pouch attached.
